Download and install
Download and install the latest version of Krisp to access the AI Meeting Assistant. Upon installation, the Meeting Assistant package will automatically begin to download.

Have questions?  We’ve got answers.
How is Krisp different than other meeting assistants?
Most assistants show up as bots in your calls. Krisp does not need to. We capture directly at the audio level, so you get clean transcripts and summaries without a visible bot. On top of that, only Krisp adds real-time Accent Conversion and industry-leading Noise Cancellation, making us more than a note taker. We are a complete Voice AI layer for your meetings.
What is the best AI assistant for meetings?
Modern AI meeting assistants are expected to automatically transcribe conversations, highlight key decisions, and generate summaries that teams can quickly review and share. From Krisp’s perspective, the ideal meeting AI assistant should also combine AI notes with real-time audio clarity and clear communications without accent barriers - and that's where Krisp stands out.
If you want to explore how different tools compare and what to look for in an AI assistant for your meeting notes, check out Best AI Note Taking Apps guide.
Will a bot join my call when I use Krisp?
No. One of the biggest differences with Krisp is that you don’t need a bot in your meeting. Krisp works directly at the audio level on your device, so you can capture, transcribe, and summarize conversations without an extra participant showing up.

If you prefer, Krisp also offers a Bot option for platforms like Zoom, where it will appear as a participant to make recording and consent handling more transparent. The choice is always yours.
Which integrations does Krisp support?
Krisp works with all major conferencing apps at the audio level, so you can use it seamlessly with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Slack Huddles, and many more. Beyond conferencing, Krisp also connects into your daily workflows with integrations such as Zapier, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Slack and more.
Does Krisp support in-person, hybrid, and online meetings?
Yes. Krisp covers all meeting types. Use the desktop app for online calls, the mobile app for in-person discussions, and the same platform to handle hybrid situations. Every conversation can be captured and summarized in one place.
Does Krisp provide Noise Cancellation and note-taking in the same app?
Yes. Krisp combines real-time Noise Cancellation and AI Note-taking in one place. That means your transcripts are already cleaned from background noise, which directly improves note quality.
Does Krisp integrate with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack?
Yes. Because Krisp works at the audio level, it integrates with every conferencing app. You can use Krisp in Zoom today, Teams tomorrow, and Slack Huddles in between. Wherever your team talks, Krisp fits in.
How accurate is Krisp transcription, and what affects quality?
Krisp transcription is tuned for real-world meetings. Accuracy remains high even in noisy environments thanks to our Noise Cancellation. You will often see better results with Krisp than with standalone transcription tools.
Which languages Krisp supports for transcription?
Krisp supports on-device English transcription for maximum privacy and speed, plus server-based transcription in 15 additional languages including Spanish, French, German, Russian, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Hindi, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Czech, Ukrainian, and Korean. We continue to expand this list.
How can I capture only a transcript without recording audio or video?
Krisp offers a Transcript Only mode that lets you generate live transcripts and meeting summaries. You can enable it directly in the app from the meeting controls, adjust it during the call through the same controls, or  from the Krisp widget.
